description: Complete China OpenStreetMap extract used to derive power facilities.
download_instructions: Automatic: prepare downloads the current china-latest.osm.pbf from Geofabrik.

description: Unit- and phase-level global power project records.
download_instructions: Manual: open the GEM page, select Download data, complete the official form, and save the workbook under data/ using its original or configured filename.

description: Project-level global energy storage database export.
download_instructions: Manual: open the Sandia GESDB project page, accept its terms of use, export projects to JSON, and save the file under data/ using its original or configured filename.

description: China provincial synthetic hourly load workbook.
download_instructions: Automatic: prepare resolves Data output.xlsx through the Figshare article API and downloads it.

description: UN-adjusted one-kilometre population raster for spatial load weighting.
download_instructions: Automatic: prepare downloads the GeoTIFF directly from the WorldPop file index.

description: ERA5 China cutout containing weather fields required for wind, solar, and runoff profiles.
download_instructions: API: accept the ERA5 licence, configure ~/.cdsapirc, then run RawDataManager.prepare('era5_china_2024'); atlite submits serial monthly requests and validates the completed cutout.

description: Original province boundary GeoJSON before geometry cleaning.
download_instructions: Automatic: prepare downloads the original province GeoJSON; geometry cleaning belongs to the standard data layer.

description: Fixed- and floating-foundation offshore wind technical-potential polygons for China from the World Bank ESMAP East Asia and Pacific archive.
download_instructions: Automatic: prepare downloads the CC BY 4.0 regional Shapefile archive; spatial standardization filters ISO_Ter1=CHN and dissolves both foundation zones into one marine zone.

description: Upstream technology-data cost and efficiency assumptions for 2025.
download_instructions: Automatic: prepare downloads outputs/costs_2025.csv from the official PyPSA technology-data repository.

description: Authorized China Electric Power Statistics Yearbook used for official comparisons.
download_instructions: Manual: obtain the authorized 2024 yearbook PDF from the publisher, CEC, or an institutional library and save it under data/ using its original or configured filename.
